title: A `--seeds` position outside the queries or targets fails mid-alignment
body:
A `Seed` (libnail) holds a query position, a target position, and start and end coordinates in each. nail checks none of them against the inputs before alignment, so a bad seed from a `--seeds` file fails deep in the pipeline.

The input survey on nail-d551f7 ran each of these against the release binary:

| Seed | What the user sees |
|---|---|
| target end past the sequence | `index out of bounds: the len is 346 but the index is 99999999`, in nail/src/pipeline/cloud_stage.rs |
| a start after its end | `index out of bounds: the len is 261 but the index is 299`, in libnail/src/align/cloud_search.rs |
| every coordinate 0 | `index out of bounds`, index 18446744073709551615, a `usize` underflow in cloud_search.rs |
| query position past the last query | `error: no prf` |
| target position past the last target | `error: no seq`, caused by `no record 99999` |

## Proposal

Check every seed read from `--seeds`. The checks are: the positions fall within the query and target counts, each coordinate is at least 1 and within the profile or target length, and no start lies after its end. A bad seed fails with the file, the line and the value out of range.

## Open

- the length checks need each profile and target, so whether they run when the file is read or as each seed reaches the pipeline
- whether seeds from mmseqs go through the same checks
